claims.evidence: Witness report shows two lenses are present, but exact lens model names/specs (18-55mm vs 50mm) are not readable in the photo.

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots.
claims.evidence: No test shots/video playback or functional evidence is shown; only the camera body and lenses are visible.
No shutter count display or camera screen readout is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens.
claims.evidence: No close-up of lens glass/front-rear elements is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No battery/charger labels or repair/warranty documentation is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Exact Nikon DSLR model is unknown; pricing varies a lot by model (e.g., entry vs midrange) and features.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body showing the exact model name/number (e.g., on the front/top/bottom plate) and the lens mount label.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/entry Nikon DSLR kit with unverified condition and features.

risks.risk: Lens focal lengths/models may not be truly 18-55mm and 50mm (could be different versions or third-party lenses).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both lenses showing the printed focal length/model text and mount markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic two-lens Nikon DSLR kit with lens specs unconfirmed.

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, haze, scratches) is not verifiable from the provided view.
risks.proof: Macro/close-up shots of both lenses’ front and rear elements under light (and a photo through the glass).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing cleaning/with possible lens wear (worst-case).

risks.risk: Camera functionality is untested (autofocus, buttons/dials, shutter actuation, exposure, video).
risks.proof: A short video clip showing autofocus working and recording, plus a photo of the camera screen with settings; ideally a test shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possible faults.

risks.risk: Shutter count claim cannot be verified; high usage can reduce value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from the camera or a connected app/software readout.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or incomplete kit (battery/charger/memory card/straps/caps/hoods).
risks.proof: A laid-out photo of everything included (battery, charger, cables, memory card, straps, lens caps/hoods) with clear labels.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body + lenses only, with accessories unconfirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the exact Nikon DSLR model name/number on the body (front/top/bottom plate).
Close-up photos of both lenses showing printed focal length/model text (confirm 18-55mm and 50mm) and whether they are Nikon/third-party.
Macro close-ups of both lenses’ front and rear elements to check for fungus, haze, and scratches.
Short video showing autofocus and recording working (and a test photo showing sharpness).
Photo/screenshot of shutter count readout (from camera/app/software).
A full accessories lay-out photo showing battery, charger, memory card (if included), straps, and all caps/hoods.
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body with two lenses present, so the item type can be priced at worst-case for unknown model, unverified lens specs, and untested functionality; seller claims cannot be relied on without the requested proof.
